name: antigravity-telemetry
description: Live context window usage, prompt cache hit rate, and token intelligence for Antigravity

antigravity.deleteToRecycleBin.markdownDescription: Move conversation files to the Windows Recycle Bin instead of deleting them permanently. Restoring a conversation also requires its `conversation_summaries` catalog row, so a restored chat may need to be re-opened from Antigravity's history.

antigravity.workspaceFilter.markdownDescription: Filter conversations and active chat telemetry to the current workspace project ("current") or show conversations from all workspaces ("all").

antigravity.sqlitePath.markdownDescription: Custom path to the sqlite3 CLI executable. If left empty, Antigravity Telemetry searches common directories (e.g. adb platform-tools) and system PATH automatically.

enumDescriptions: Automatically detect based on active editor (Antigravity IDE or VS Code Extension) and include matching or running Antigravity CLI sessions
Merge conversations from all sources (Antigravity IDE, Extension, and CLI)
antigravity.dataSource.markdownDescription: Source of Antigravity telemetry: 'auto' (detects active editor and matching/running CLI sessions), 'cli' (Antigravity CLI terminal sessions), 'ide' (Antigravity IDE standalone), 'extension' (Antigravity Extension in VS Code), or 'all' (merges all sources).

antigravity.enableCache.markdownDescription: Enable persistent disk caching for instant startup (< 50ms). When disabled, no cache files are written to disk and telemetry is freshly re-scanned from SQLite on startup.
